title: oh.war/pack/v1 (a type pack's pack.toml)
description: Hand-written and normative for a type pack's `pack.toml` (packs/README.md): a versioned set of document types beyond the core ones, each in the `oh.war/profile/v1` format (profile.json). FORMAT-1.0.md does not mention packs; where it and this schema disagree, the prose wins and this schema is the defect. Not expressed here: that each named file exists beside `pack.toml` and is admitted as a profile.

version.description: The pack's version (both shipped packs use a semantic version; the reader admits any non-empty string).

note.description: Prose for a reader; carries no meaning.

profiles.description: The pack's profile files, by file name beside pack.toml.
